categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: electronic weighing instruments and electronic materials. The weighing segment involves R&D, manufacturing, and sales of various electronic scales and smart weighing systems used in commercial, industrial, laboratory, and healthcare fields. The materials segment focuses on EMI shielding materials, including conductive fabrics, foams, tapes, and advanced copper foil products for applications in consumer electronics, automotive electronics, and high-performance computing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include vacuum sputtering, electroplating, and advanced coating processes for EMI materials, as well as sensor technology, digital filtering, temperature compensation, and embedded operating systems for electronic scales. The company employs modular design, IoT integration, and AI-based image recognition in smart weighing systems. Production methods emphasize automation, precision calibration, and vertical integration from raw materials to finished products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global OEMs and brand manufacturers in consumer electronics (notebooks, tablets, smartphones), automotive electronics (new energy vehicles), industrial sectors, retail chains, laboratories, and healthcare institutions. The company serves over 80 countries with a diversified customer base, including major international electronics and automotive companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with operations and subsidiaries in Taiwan, China (Kunshan, Huai'an, Chongqing, Shanghai), Hong Kong, Samoa, India, Vietnam, Thailand, and the United States. It actively expands production bases in Southeast Asia, particularly Thailand and Vietnam, to enhance supply chain resilience and market reach.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on R&D, manufacturing, and sales of electronic weighing instruments and EMI shielding materials. It maintains vertical integration in the materials segment, controlling processes from raw material preparation to precision cutting and assembly, enabling customized and high-quality product delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding Southeast Asian production capacity, enhancing talent development, and driving digital transformation and smart manufacturing. R&D focuses on high-frequency, high-speed copper foil materials, AI-enabled smart weighing systems, and multifunctional EMI shielding materials with improved thermal and electromagnetic properties. The company aims to penetrate high-growth markets such as 5G, automotive electronics, semiconductors, and high-performance computing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of electronic weighing instruments and electronic materials. The company also provides OEM/ODM services for global brands. It leverages its proprietary technologies and product customization capabilities to maintain competitive pricing and market share.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In electronic weighing instruments, major global competitors include Mettler Toledo (USA/Switzerland), Bizerba (Germany), DIGI (Japan), CAS (South Korea), and Guangdong Xiangshan (China). In EMI materials, competitors include Parker Hannifin, Gore, Laird Technologies (USA/UK), A-JIN Electron (South Korea), and several Chinese manufacturers. The company positions itself as a technologically advanced, vertically integrated supplier with strong R&D and global sales networks, competing effectively in mid-to-high-end markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported net revenue of approximately NT$2.04 billion in 2024, representing a 10.27% increase from 2023. Operating profit grew by 16.92%, and net profit after tax increased by 8.90%. Total assets reached about NT$12.21 billion, with equity of NT$11.31 billion, reflecting steady growth and expansion in production capacity. R&D investment accounted for 8.56% of revenue in 2024, underscoring commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high precision, reliability, and smart integration in its electronic weighing products, supported by proprietary embedded operating systems and AI capabilities. In materials, it offers advanced EMI shielding solutions with superior coating uniformity, adhesion, corrosion resistance, and multifunctionality (shielding, absorption, thermal management). Vertical integration and customization capabilities enable cost-effective, high-quality products tailored to diverse customer needs, enhancing competitiveness in global markets.
